# L4′ — Scientific

**MEF lens `L4′`** · Square B — Encounter `[1 + 4]`: cause ⇄ experience, structure ⇄ investigation · Night face · index `#4′` · tonic `A` · ground-pair **Love** (Power-led) · twin: [L4 — Phenomenological](L4-phenomenological.md)

*Root:* Kuhn, Miessler scientific loop · *Element:* Earth · *Möbius:* `L4′ → L1`

The same Son/Love rotation grounded on the Power-face: method as the verification-loop that *holds* (Love) the personal discovery (Son). **(Correction: not "all Name" — it grounds on Love, the Power-face, and carries the full `6+6`.)** Read in a 7-position sense with an overarching *Learn* macro-environment.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L4.0′ — Observe** (`Love[A]` / `Son[G♯]`) — establish the Current State; disciplined not-yet-knowing.

- **L4.1′ — Think** (`Work[B]` / `Image[A♯]`) — hypothesis formation, ideal-state imagination from evidence.

- **L4.2′ — Plan** (`Play[C♯]` / `Truth[C]`) — experimental design, method selection, incorporating the field's resistance.

- **L4.3′ — Build** (`Need[D♯]` / `Mind[D]`) — build the *evaluative apparatus*: tests, harnesses, pass/fail criteria.

- **L4.4′ — Execute** (`Sacrifice[F]` / `Word[E]`) — run the experiment; execution reveals what could not be known in advance.

- **L4.5′ — Verify** (`Decision[G]` / `Logos[F♯]`) — analyse against criteria; only what survives crystallises into insight and ascends into *Learn*.


## Derivation at this index

*Shares `L4`'s 8-fold and diatonic* — sounding Image·Truth·Mind·Word + Work·Play·Need·Sacrifice; anchors Son, Logos, Love, Decision; diatonic Son–Image–Truth · Play–Need–Sacrifice–Decision.

*Reading:* grounded on Love, care becomes disciplined procedure — the objective loop that holds the personal discovery; the Name hexad rides as the articulable artifact-trail (Questions→Insight), but the ground is the caring Power-face.
